content.text: The atlas tool was denied, so I'll fall back to normal search.

The logic is in `src/lib/credential-delivery.ts`. The atlas tool was denied, so I found it with grep. I haven't opened the file, so these descriptions come from the function names and the tests that import them.

- **`isValidActivationUrl`** (line 13) checks whether a value is a valid activation URL.
- **`getDeliveryKind`** (line 37) classifies a delivered credential, for example as an activation link, license key or account. It returns a `DeliveryKind`.
- **`getUnitCopyValue`** (line 76) builds the copyable string for a unit, given the credential and its kind.

`test/s02-purchases-drawer.test.ts` imports and tests all three.

Two related places also build text for delivered credentials:

- **Text receipts and exports:** `ReceiptService.formatTextReceipt` in `src/services/receipt.service.ts:461` builds the receipt text. It prints "Activation URL: …" for `activation_link` credentials. The vault export route (`app/api/customer/vault/export/route.ts:121`) and the Google Drive sync route call it.
- **Supplier intake:** `app/portal/supplier/intake-hub/page.tsx:36-53` defines `IntakeFormatMode` and handles `activation_link` input. `app/portal/supplier/page.tsx:189` has a `^https?://` regex check.

I can read `credential-delivery.ts` and walk through the logic if you want.
